articles.title: Folgen des Irankriegs: US-Benzinpreis erreicht Höchststand seit Beginn des Irankriegs
articles.teaser: Mit über vier US-Dollar pro Gallone ist Benzin in den USA so teuer wie seit Beginn des Ukrainekriegs nicht. Die US-Energiebehörde rechnet mit monatelangen hohen Preisen.
articles.image_title: Folgen des Irankriegs: EL SEGUNDO, CALIFORNIA - APRIL 08: Customers gather at a Chevron gas station near the Pacific Ocean on April 8, 2026 in El Segundo, California. California imports approximately 75 percent of its crude oil with nearly one-third of the crude supplied from the Middle East as prices at the pump in the state are averaging $5.93 per gallon today amid the war in Iran. (Photo by Mario Tama/Getty Images)

articles.title: Anzeige: "Man spürt sehr früh, was politisch und wirtschaftlich relevant wird"

articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); Argentinien: Mehr Milei wagen? Die Bilanz ist verheerend

articles.image_title: Argentinien: A dentist provides free medical attention to a patient during a 24-hour ''Japanese-style strike'' organized by the Faculty of Dentistry of the University of Buenos Aires (FOUBA) at Plaza Houssay in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on April 15, 2026. Students, teachers, and non-teaching staff offer free dental, medical, and legal services for 24 consecutive hours to protest against the national government's budget cuts and to advocate for the implementation of the University Financing Law. The event aims to emphasize the importance of public education and healthcare amid the ongoing economic situation in the country. (Photo by Catriel Gallucci Bordoni/NurPhoto via Getty Images)

Dabei sind die Unternehmer Rolf Schumann (Co-CEO Schwarz Digits, 2.v.l.), Samuel Weinbach (M, Co-Founder Aleph Alpha) und Aidan Gomez (Co-Founder und CEO Cohere). +++ dpa-Bildfunk +++
